title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
Orientation day on campus.


My first day as a part of the UBC Master of DS program was August 26th, 2026. From August 26th, 2026 to August 28th, 2026 it was the MDS orientation, which was a great couple of days that allowed me to meet all of my classmates, meet alumni, learn more about the program and talk to poeple I wil be working with and around for the next 10 months. It was really interesting meeting everyone and hearing about everyones unique background and path into this program. I feel like meeting such a diverse group of people allowed me to gain an appreciatation for everyone’s unique path in live. For example, I chose to complete this program directly after my undergraduate degree however there are a number of poeple that have been out of school for a nubmer of years and also people who have been working in industry and are looking to furthere thier eductation such that it will help them grow at their position.
After the first week of classes, i quickly learned that the classes and assignemnts are super challenging and that we will be learning alot of content within the short timeframe of 10 months. I feel like i spent most of this first week learning the best ways to learn. for example, I learned that I learn the best when i am working in a study group and in the library. I also learned that it is important to take regualr study breaks whether that means taking breaks to eat or to go to the gym, its good to try to keep a work-life balance.
I am now in the second week, and it is still moving super quick but I am excited to keep making new friends and making



Trip to Science World.

title: About
text: My name is Nitpreet Bamra. I graduated from the University of Waterloo with a degree in Mechatronics engineering in April 2026. I currently attend the University of British Columbia where I am working to get a Master’s of Data Science. Aside from school, I like to travel – with some of my favourite places to visit being Italy, and New York City. Other than that, I like to play alot of sports including : basketball, running, soccer and football.

title: About
text:
Why data science
I believe that data science is a good intersection between data analytics and software engineering which is what drew me to the field. I have experience working in both data analytics and in machine learning which i feel like gives me the ideal background to continue learning data science. Furthermore, the prospect of building my own machine learning models as well as developing scalable ML ops pipeline is what I aspire to learn/develop in this field. I also feel like data science allows us to automate industry level decision as a scalable level, which is something that I find very inticing.

title: About
text:
Outside of data science
Outside of data science, I like to learn about software engineering and different system design. For example, I like to learn about how many of the worlds most popular software services/products work/operate. For example, one of the projects I find the most interesting is Google maps. I learned that in Google maps they leverage A-star search algorithm which is an algorithm I learned during my undergrad. Beyond this, I like to spend time listening to music, going to museums and reading books

title: Penguin Body Mass by Species
text:
Clean the data

penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(
    subset=["species", "sex", "body_mass_g"]
)

penguins_clean.shape

(333, 8)


Rows with missing values for species, sex, or body mass were removed before performing the analysis.

title: Penguin Body Mass by Species
text:
Average body mass

mass_per_species = (
penguins_clean.groupby(by="species").agg(
    {
        "body_mass_g": ["mean"]

     )
)
